failures.baseline: Herdr can launch material work without a Board admission
failures.target: A material launch requires a durable Board admission tied to card and run identity

failures.baseline: Card description and comments are free text rather than a reduced contract projection
failures.target: Structured references, digests, predicates and receipts render the operational description

failures.baseline: Card, run, pane and tab display state are updated by separate paths
failures.target: One deterministic reducer commits projection changes and idempotent effects atomically

failures.baseline: A failed spawn finalizes the queued run as failed before prompt acknowledgement
failures.target: A pre-ack spawn failure is an interrupted attempt with bounded retry

failures.baseline: A dead review shell has no typed receipt-aware recovery transition
failures.target: A review without a receipt returns safely to Human Gate

failures.baseline: Approved review feedback does not deterministically materialize successor work
failures.target: Receipts classify as approve-only, approve-with-follow-up, revision-required or reject

failures.baseline: Safe successor work can require a manual move or retry
failures.target: The controller advances eligible cards until a real gate or blocker

failures.baseline: Editable description text is the launch prompt base
failures.target: A versioned structured contract is authority and human context remains non-reducible

failures.baseline: Declared dependencies and external evidence have no controller watchdog evaluation
failures.target: A watchdog refreshes declared evidence without inventing cards or priority

identity: card_id, run_id, tab_id and pane_id remain exact identities
legacy: cards without display codes keep card-<id>
pre-v11 kanban placement is not adopted or renamed heuristically
workspace: a descendant Git path resolves to its canonical repository root
launch cwd is the canonical root while task_path preserves scope
one active binding maps a session and repository root to one exact workspace
human_gate: a checkpoint binds request_id, question, options, artifact path, digest, effect and authority
approve, request-changes and block decisions are durable events
a decision applies only to the exact checkpoint revision and digest
